en: A vintage, blue-tinted postcard view over a harbor area with several passenger boats and smaller vessels docked along the quay. In the background are tree-lined streets, a busy square with horse‑drawn carriages and early automobiles, and large ornate stone buildings. A prominent building with a grand façade and columned entrance is visible to the right; this is the Dramaten (Royal Dramatic Theatre). The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Stockholm's Nybroplan with the Dramatiska Teatern.
